gcm.purpose: Keep GCM OS as the Handle Now home base while immediate external tasks open beside Morning Command.
changeNotes: Updates the Morning Command Gmail decision surface to 2.2.0.
Extracts usable task links generically from the live Gmail source before presentation cleanup and opens them in a separate browser context.
Keeps Open Email in Gmail as a fallback while preserving the current Morning Command card and explicit completion boundary.
Extends permanent Handle Now and Source Email regression coverage without adding sender-specific, client-specific, or AI routing rules.
